snippet.title: Hotel Carnivalia | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Hotel Carnivalia on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5086950/Hotel_Carnivalia/

The free Steam demo launches October 13, 2026 at 7:00 PM PDT:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5318800/Hotel_Carnivalia_Demo/

Debate by day. Fight by night.

Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4–15 players, set in a gothic hotel where every guest has a secret role.

Hunt as a predator, or follow the evidence to uncover the predators hiding among you. At night, enter other guests’ rooms to investigate, hide, or fight. Every role can fight back. If you survive, be ready to explain yourself the next morning.

Bring your friends. We recommend around 8 players.

Join the DARELARK Studio Discord for playtest news and updates:
https://discord.gg/hBQqwDXXbs

Developed by DARELARK Studio.
